create_pipeline_class: create a Pipeline class with Valves configuration for Llama Index Ollama RAG pipeline
build_rag_index: build a RAG index from documents in /app/backend/data using Llama Index VectorStoreIndex
run_rag_query: run a streaming RAG query against the Llama Index knowledge base with a user message
configure_ollama_settings: configure Ollama base URL, model name, and embedding model for the RAG pipeline
run_pipeline_lifecycle: run the pipeline lifecycle with on_startup and on_shutdown hooks for initialization and cleanup
